statement: ∀ (q r ε : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → 0 < ε → 0 < q ∧ ∃ V : ℕ → Set (YuiEucl n), YuiCover r E V ∧ YuiCost q V < ENNReal.ofReal ε
proof:
intro q r ε hD hr hε
have hq : 0 < q := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp ((h_T005.1.1).trans_lt hD)
have hm : YuiMeasure q E = 0 := (h_T002.1 n E q hq).2.1 hD
have hc : YuiContent q r E = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
  calc
    _ ≤ YuiMeasure q E := le_iSup_of_le r (le_iSup_of_le hr le_rfl)
    _ = 0 := hm
have hi : (⨅ (V : ℕ → Set (YuiEucl n)) (_ : YuiCover r E V), YuiCost q V) <
    ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
  change YuiContent q r E < _
  rw [hc]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hε
rcases (iInf_lt_iff.mp hi) with ⟨V, hV⟩
rcases (iInf_lt_iff.mp hV) with ⟨hcov, hcost⟩
exact ⟨hq, V, hcov, hcost⟩

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  E.Nonempty →
    ((∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (a : ℝ),
          0 < a →
            YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
              (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
                (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                  (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧ (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
            ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
      ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
        ∀ (q r ε : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → 0 < ε → 0 < q ∧ ∃ V, YuiCover r E V ∧ YuiCost q V < ENNReal.ofReal ε
